native_review.summary: The user (Sofia Li) contacted support to exchange a delivered digital camera for one with maximum zoom while keeping all other specifications identical (24MP, SD card), and requested using PayPal for any price difference. The agent correctly authenticated the user via name and zip code, found the delivered camera order #W4689314, and reviewed the available camera variants. No available variant satisfied the user's requirement of a higher zoom with the same 24MP and SD card specs, so the user decided to keep the current camera and ended the conversation. The agent committed minor policy violations by making multiple tool calls in a single turn (Turn 8) and by combining a user message with a tool call (Turn 13). No user errors were found.

errors.reasoning: The agent made four get_order_details tool calls in a single turn and also sent a user-facing message in the same turn. This violates the policy that the agent may make at most one tool call at a time and may not respond to the user while making a tool call.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have made one tool call at a time, waiting for each tool response before making the next call, and should not have combined a user message with tool calls.

errors.reasoning: The agent sent a message to the user and made a get_product_details tool call in the same turn, violating the policy that the agent should not respond to the user and make a tool call at the same time.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have either responded to the user without making a tool call, or made the tool call without responding to the user in the same turn.

auth_classification.reasoning: The agent requested identity verification at the start, and the user provided their name and ZIP code. The agent used the find_user_id_by_name_zip tool, successfully located the account (sofia_li_9219), and then retrieved account details, confirming the user's identity and orders. This constitutes a successful authentication.
